confidence_notes: Figma provided a complete, concrete Create Quiz wizard (3 steps with exact field labels, placeholders, and hint copy), the Quiz tab list and empty state, the end-user quiz-taking pattern, the admin per-user score drill-down, and Advanced Reporting filters. Confidence is high on structure and copy. Gaps are concentrated in system behavior not visible in static frames: attempt-exhaustion handling, JSON validation rules, duplicate-assignment handling, RBAC, and whether a dedicated Assign Quiz wizard exists distinct from the generic row-level Assign action. Step-label text was also inconsistent across frames (Basic Info/Content/Publish vs Basic Info/Quiz/Publish vs Basic Info/Review/Publish) — treated as the same 3-step wizard, but the naming should be confirmed with design.
